articles.title: ETtech Explainer: Inside the Instagram child sexual abuse ad controversy
articles.summary: Instagram has come under fire after a BBC investigation revealed it approved paid ads promoting child sexual abuse material, directing users to Telegram. India's IT Ministry has issued a notice to Meta, demanding an explanation for its ad review process and safeguards. Meta claims zero tolerance and has removed the ads, but the government awaits a detailed response within seven days before deciding on further action.

articles.title: ETtech Explainer: What the Tata Electronics hack exposed about Apple and Tesla
articles.summary: Confidential documents belonging to Apple and Tesla have surfaced on the dark web following a ransomware attack on Indian manufacturer Tata Electronics.
